body: ADVISOR RULING (02:00): your probe shows exactly the condition, so make it structural. EVERY install-phase root must be its own top-level bind, never nested inside another rw-bound root: put PREFIX (and any other install-writable dir) in sibling directories OUTSIDE ScoreEnv.root (e.g. <score-run>/trial and <score-run>/prefix, with the parent <score-run> itself NOT bound rw into either sandbox). Quarantine-rename then applies per root. Add an assertion at sandbox construction that no rw root is an ancestor or descendant of another rw root (refuse otherwise), plus a test. Re-run the fork+setsid reproduction on the real scorer layout: the new prefix and new trial counters must stay 0. #2664 (TASK-1731 controls) stays a draft until #2660 is approved; it inherits this layout.
subject: RULING: #2660 non-nested rw roots
